purpose: Collect new earnings expectations, stock money flow, announcement events, and derived industry prosperity without tuning on seen 2019-2025 outcomes.

approved_sources.announcement_events: existing frozen announcement_body_v5r2 CNINFO first-seen ledger
approved_sources.industry_prosperity: derived only from prospectively observed expectations plus PIT CNINFO industry effective dates

rules: Raw HTTP pages are append-only and SHA-256 bound to every normalized row.
Observation time, provider source time, membership snapshot, and industry effective date remain separate fields.
Historical analyst, northbound, and announcement archives remain isolated and cannot be relabeled as prospective PIT.
The first observation is a baseline; industry revisions require a prior observation with the same forecast year.
At least 20 distinct prospective observations plus matured labels are required before any model experiment; this is not a 126-day production gate.
No prices, returns, model fitting, parameter search, broker connection, or order execution is allowed in this data phase.
